Japan's (JPN) **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** for the period starting 2026-05-01. It ranks **32nd of 121** countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population, with 1.0 as the global average. At 1.91, Japan's Claude usage is about 91% higher than its population alone would predict.

Other figures, compared with the global average:
- **Use case:** 47% work (global 43%), 47% personal (global 40%) and 6% coursework (global 16%).
- **Augmentation vs. automation:** 53% / 47% (global 51% / 49%).

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
